test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT considered as the reason for the failure of the Third Five-Year Plan in achievement of its targets?
solution:
The correct answer is **Change of government**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chinese aggression:** The Third Five-Year Plan faced setbacks due to the Sino-Indian War of 1962.
 
• **Indo-Pak war:** The 1965 war with Pakistan further strained resources and affected the plan's targets.
 
• **Severe drought:** A severe drought during the plan period led to agricultural shortfalls and economic challenges.
 
• **Change of government:** This was not a factor in the failure of the Third Five-Year Plan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The **Third Five-Year Plan** (1961-1966) aimed at making India self-reliant and self-generating in the economy. The plan focused on agriculture, industry, and infrastructure development. However, several unforeseen events led to its failure.

 
 

 Event
 Impact
 
 
 
 

 Chinese aggression (1962)
 Diverted resources to defense, causing a strain on economic resources.
 
 

 Indo-Pak war (1965)
 Further strained the economy and disrupted development activities.
 
 

 Severe drought (1965-66)
 Led to agricultural shortfalls, food shortages, and economic instability.
